name: Respirometer Three Ball Breathing Exerciser
description:
Respirometer Exerciser – 3-Ball Incentive Spirometer for Lung Training
Key Features:

Durable & Compact: Made from high-quality, break-resistant plastic for long-lasting use.

3-Ball Inhalation System: Features a 3-ball incentive spirometer to measure inhalation strength and help track progress.

Stable & Solid: Non-shaky construction ensures accurate readings during exercises.

Easy to Clean: Removable bottom allows thorough cleaning and hygiene maintenance.

Comprehensive Respiratory Training:

3 chambers with varying inhalation rates (600cc/sec to 1200cc/sec) for progressive lung capacity training.

Supports restoring disrupted breathing patterns and achieving optimal lung function.

User-Friendly: Comes with complete instructions; instructional video included in images.

Note: Ball colors may vary.
